rawContent: On the other side of the coin since you’ll never know if you’ve got a good cop or bad. Take the advice my dad gave me when I started driving.  Always leave your hands visable. Give yes and no answers. Apologize and do exactly as the cop says. We need change! #BlackLivesMatter
Just saw a P&G ad that teared me up. The talk is real and for those that don’t yet understand we live in 2 separate worlds. #TheTalk #BlackLivesMatter
